authorization: User explicitly requested using the correct research/Python Cox scale and rerunning on2026-11-02; licensed SOCP and native/Python parity preflight performed.
probability: sum rejected / sum max(processed-1000,0); three disjoint calibration seeds; constant per problem
zero_exposure: p=0 fallback only for three valid natural stagnation stops; flag evaluation mismatch
fit_failure: Retain valid completed run with identifiable lifelines ConvergenceError as disabled filter; retain exposure and zero rejections, report failure. Unknown/import/I-O/model/partial failures halt for diagnosis, no automatic tuning.
timeouts: Validated solver time-limit outcome retained and labeled; outer process kill or partial output halts. No automated increase of limits.
retry: Technical cause fixed, new attempt directory, same seeds/settings, affected implementation versions never pooled; no blind retries.
analysis: 53 equally weighted problem means from five seeds; primary Cox versus random cost and total solver seconds; secondary versus none. Six two-sided Wilcoxon comparisons with Holm correction; 10000 problem bootstrap percentile 95% descriptive intervals; no equivalence claim; all 795 valid outcomes required, no silent exclusions.
execution: 159 new independent Cox calibration runs on4workers, then freeze new probabilities, then795 new evaluation runs on4workers. Prior randomized ordering and settings retained.
time_guard: Fresh post-training timestamp for explicit modes; cooperative per-iteration inner guard, outer process timeout separate. Existing stagnation rule unchanged.
disk_policy: No preemptive free-space cutoff; actual I/O failures still halt and preserve outputs.
power_policy: Process-lifetime Windows system-idle-sleep request; manual shutdown/sleep not prevented.
restart_reason: Gurobi license failure invalidated prior new campaigns; Cox native scale corrected to actual lifelines export contract.
runtime_interpretation: Four-worker concurrent solver times with working licensed SOCP and preserved numeric fallback; old timings and the previous unlicensed parallel timing probe are not pooled or used as a new duration forecast.
pause_policy: STOP_AFTER_CURRENT file: no new runs, currently active runs finish and validate. Technical failure also stops new runs and drains peers.
cox_formula: exp(sum(beta*(x-training_mean))); no extra std division; same scale as Python threshold
socp_policy: Require explicit status and solution count. Optimal/suboptimal with available solution are used. GRB_NUMERIC/status12 with zero solutions retains input candidate, matching historical fallback, and is explicitly counted. License exceptions and all other unexpected errors halt; never read unavailable X.
validation: Every run must contain consistent explicit SOCP status/success/fallback evidence and no swallowed errors; Cox model metadata must declare raw-centered coefficient scale. All original ledger/model/startup identity checks retained.
